reference_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' AND country_code = 'NL' THEN 'next_day'
            WHEN channel = 'web' AND country_code IN ('BE', 'LU') THEN 'two_day'
            ELSE 'in_store'
       END AS delivery,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY delivery
alternatives: SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 'in_store' WHEN country_code = 'NL' THEN 'next_day' ELSE 'two_day' END AS delivery, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' AND country_code = 'NL' THEN 'next_day' WHEN channel = 'web' AND (country_code = 'BE' OR country_code = 'LU') THEN 'two_day' ELSE 'in_store' END AS delivery, COUNT(order_line_id) AS n_lines, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY delivery

other_way.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 'in_store' WHEN country_code = 'NL' THEN 'next_day' ELSE 'two_day' END AS delivery, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM sales GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: Tests the store channel first and treats the rest as web, which is shorter, but mislabels any new channel.

solver.query:

            WHEN channel = 'web' AND country_code IN ('BE', 'LU') THEN 'two_day'
            WHEN channel = 'store' THEN 'in_store' END AS delivery,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(units) AS units_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY 1
